items.title: Bitcoin mining pool once handling 2.3% of network shuts after hashrate falls 65%
items.snippet: Computing power directed at Binance Pool has fallen from 26 EH/s in December to about 9 EH/s. Its remaining miners must choose another provider before a Nov. 10 cutoff.
